_help: Edit this file to change what Emma knows. Keep the quotes and commas exactly as they are. Times use 24-hour format, e.g. "20:00" = 8 PM. After saving, restart the agent.
name: Cramble Restaurant
parking: Free parking for 30 cars behind the restaurant, plus street parking on Harbour Street after 6 PM.
dress_code: Smart casual. No beachwear or sports vests in the evening, please.
other_info: Wheelchair accessible, with an accessible restroom.
High chairs and a kids menu are available.
Well-behaved dogs are welcome on the outdoor terrace.

events.deposit_note: A 25 percent deposit secures the date. It is refundable up to 7 days before the event.

packages.name: Classic Celebration
packages.includes: Three-course set menu, a welcome soft drink, table decorations, and a dedicated server.

packages.name: Premium Party
packages.includes: Welcome glass of prosecco, canapés, three-course menu with choice of mains, a custom cake, and balloon decoration.

packages.name: Corporate Dinner
packages.includes: Private Garden Room, four-course dinner, wine pairing, projector and microphone, and printed menus with your company name.

Starters.name: Crispy Calamari
Starters.description: Tender squid rings in a light, crunchy batter, fried golden and served with a zesty lemon-garlic aioli.

Starters.name: Roasted Tomato Soup
Starters.description: Slow-roasted vine tomatoes blended silky smooth with a swirl of basil oil, served with warm sourdough.

Starters.name: Spicy Chicken Wings
Starters.description: Wings marinated overnight, roasted till sticky in our house chilli-honey glaze, with a cooling blue cheese dip.

Starters.name: Burrata and Peach Salad
Starters.description: Creamy burrata with grilled peaches, rocket, toasted hazelnuts and a drizzle of aged balsamic.

Starters.name: Garlic Prawns
Starters.description: Juicy king prawns sizzled in garlic butter, chilli and parsley, with crusty bread to mop up the juices.

Mains.name: Grilled Lamb Chops
Mains.description: Marinated overnight in garlic and rosemary, grilled till juicy inside with a smoky crust, served with creamy mash.

Mains.name: Cramble Beef Burger
Mains.description: A thick, juicy beef patty with aged cheddar, caramelised onions and house pickles in a toasted brioche bun, with skin-on fries.

Mains.name: Pan-Seared Salmon
Mains.description: Crispy-skinned salmon on a bed of lemony crushed potatoes and green beans, finished with a light dill butter sauce.

Mains.name: Wild Mushroom Risotto
Mains.description: Creamy arborio rice slow-stirred with wild mushrooms, white wine and parmesan, topped with crispy sage.

Mains.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
Mains.description: Chargrilled chicken in a rich, gently spiced tomato and cream sauce, with fluffy basmati rice and garlic naan.

Mains.name: Ribeye Steak
Mains.description: Ten ounces of grass-fed ribeye, cooked the way you like it, with peppercorn sauce and hand-cut chips.

Mains.name: Vegan Buddha Bowl
Mains.description: Roasted sweet potato, crispy chickpeas, quinoa, avocado and pickled red cabbage with a creamy tahini dressing.

Desserts.name: Sticky Toffee Pudding
Desserts.description: Warm, moist date sponge soaked in buttery toffee sauce, with a scoop of vanilla ice cream.

Desserts.name: Chocolate Lava Cake
Desserts.description: A rich chocolate cake with a gooey molten centre, served warm with raspberry sorbet.

Desserts.name: Lemon Tart
Desserts.description: Crisp buttery pastry filled with a sharp, silky lemon curd and a dusting of icing sugar.

Desserts.name: Mango Sorbet
Desserts.description: Light and refreshing, made with ripe Alphonso mangoes.

Drinks.name: Fresh Lemonade
Drinks.description: Freshly squeezed lemons with a hint of mint, lightly sweetened.

Drinks.name: Mango Lassi
Drinks.description: A creamy, chilled yoghurt and mango drink.

Drinks.name: House Red Wine (glass)
Drinks.description: A smooth, fruity Merlot with soft plum notes.

Drinks.name: Craft Beer
Drinks.description: A rotating local craft beer on tap. Ask your server what is pouring today.
